assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The organiser has not published an exact official SITE_BOUNDARY or KEY_AREA polygon; this package uses the repository's calibrated provisional rough polygons.
assumptions.impact: All boundaries, land-use partition, key-area ranges, phasing and precision-sensitive metrics are provisional and must be recalculated when official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Areas are computed by projecting EPSG:4326 geometry to EPSG:4548; values agree with the provisional polygon area checks but are not statutory precise areas.
assumptions.impact: Area values support design discussion and self-check only; they are not official redline or precise-area claims.

assumptions.statement: The buildings layer expresses conceptual building baselines at the three station cores, not the whole-district building stock.
assumptions.impact: Building density and footprint metrics reflect station-core conceptual clusters; total floor area and development intensity are pending official regulatory conditions.

assumptions.statement: Floor-area ratio, building height, building density, setback and road redlines are not provided in the cleared site package and are recorded as missing in planning_limits.json.
assumptions.impact: These indicators are listed as unknown with reason in metrics.json and treated as pending official regulatory-plan conditions.

assumptions.statement: Road centre-lines and the Qing River line are indicative design/context geometry, not statutory redlines or blue lines.
assumptions.impact: Road-area ratio is an illustrative buffered value; exact road and river controls await official attachments.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios, pilgrimage landmarks, events, operations and attraction arrangements are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: They are not approved operations, confirmed government arrangements, investment commitments or engineering feasibility conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Branding, signage, landmark, font, image, portrait and corporate-mark references must be rights-cleared before any implementation.
assumptions.impact: Visual identity elements in this package are directional; no unlicensed material is asserted as approved for use.
